_meta.source: ipfs-probe/results.jsonl + errors.log, probed against ipfs.dapperlabs.com 2026-08-29; incremental probe 2026-09-02 (scripts/probe-missing.mjs); incremental probe 2026-09-02 (scripts/probe-missing.mjs)
_meta.format: cid: ['jpg'|'png'|'mpo', width, height, bytes|null, author?, camera?, photoDate?] for images (trailing nulls trimmed; credit/camera/date from EXIF where present); ['mp4', width, height, bytes|null, durationSeconds, videoKbps|null, audioKbps (0 = silent)] for videos; 0 = registered but missing at the gateway
_meta.uniform: every video is h264 in an mp4 container at ~30fps; when bytes is null, estimate as durationSeconds x (videoKbps + audioKbps) x 125
_meta.note: CIDs are content-addressed, so entries never go stale; only additive updates for new editions are ever needed. Mismint editions were skipped by the probe. 86 CIDs omitted (transient probe failures, unknown status).
